feature: Build from — free mode lists from the free pool
note: One lane, and one control inside it. `/discover` is photographed because the control is deliberately ABSENT there (locked decision 3) and because the shared end-of-ranking rule was restated; a shot of that lane is the only way to show an absence stayed an absence. The sheet rows are phone-only: above 1024px the rack draws `Build from` inline and there is no sheet to open, so photographing one at desktop width would put a hole in the sheet about a form that never exists. Two states are NOT here and cannot be: the free-mode zero state needs a collection whose every commander is sleeved, and the end-of-ranking rule needs a windowed list revealed to its end. Both are pinned by unit tests instead, and both are named in the PR body so the gap is stated rather than implied.
